senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. גבב) to be uppermost, prevail; to be strong.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:4">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>לשון גָּבַר</he>, v. <cite ref="A02150"><he>אָנוּשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite> <he>גָּבְרוּ בעלי זרוע</he> the violent prevailed.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 2:7:2">Y. Bets. II, 61ᶜ</cite> top; <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 2:11">Tosef. Ḥag. II, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Beitzah 20a:13">Bets. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>גָּבְרָה יָדָן וכ׳</he> the Shammaites prevailed over (outnumbered) the Hillelites; a. fr.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:13">Lam. R. to III, 1</cite> <he>גִּבְּרַנִי לעמוד בכולן</he> he made me strong enough to survive all these calamities; ib. 12.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14">Cant. R. to II, 14</cite> <he>מְגַבְּרָן לישראל</he> (ed. Wil. <he>מַגְבִּירָן</he> Hif.) sustains Israel.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:7">Ib. III, 7</cite> <he>שהן מְגַבְּרִין את וכ׳</he> they (the sixty words of the priestly benediction) strengthen Israel. Mekh. B’shall., Amalek, s. 1 <he>וכי … מְגַבְּרוֹת ישראל</he> can Moses’ (uplifted) hands make Israel victorious?; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְגוּבָּר</he>, v. infra.

senses.gloss: to grow strong. Ib. עתידין … לְהַגְבִּיר בד״ת וכ׳ (Moses’ uplifted hands indicated that the Lord remembered that) Israel would in the future be strong in the Law which was to be given through his (Moses’) hands, opp. להמיך; Yalk. Ex. 264.
, Nithpa. נִתְגַּבֵּר to rise, swell; to grow strong, gather courage; to make one’s self master. Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Genesis 7">B’resh. 7</cite> <he>המים מִתְגַּבְּרִין</he> the waters of the Nile rose.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:25">Num. R. s. 19</cite> <he>ומִתְגַּבֶּרֶת שם</he> and rose there.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Ib.</cite> <he>מלא מים מְגוּבָּרִין</he> full of high waters.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96a:4">Snh. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>לא נ׳ עד וכ׳</he> had no courage until he came to Dan.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:8">R. Hash. III, 8</cite> <he>היו מִתְגַּבְּרִין</he> they were victorious.
<cite ref="Chagigah 16a">Ḥag. 16ᵃ</cite>, a. e. if one feels <he>שיצרו מתג׳ עליו</he> that his passion threatens to make itself master over him; <cite ref="Kiddushin 80b:11">Kidd. 80ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 81a:3">Ned. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני שהן מתגברין על הצבור</he> because they lord it over the people (Ar. <he>מתגדרין</he>, v. <cite ref="C00244"><he>גָּדַר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:22">Num. R. s. 18</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00049"><he>גָּבַהּ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 287">Yalk. Is. 287</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 17:11">Is. XVII, 11</cite>) <he>מכה מִתְגַּבֶּרֶת</he> (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <cite ref="M00229"><he>מגרת</he></cite>, corr. acc. or <he>מגברת</he>) an affliction which makes itself the master, v. <cite ref="A02150"><he>אָנוּשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 76">Gen. R. s. 76</cite>; a. fr.
